The decision made today by the Supreme Court’s conservative majority was dishonest and shameful.

I want to share some thoughts on what it means — and how we move forward.

Video

From the courts to the state legislatures, Republicans are deploying every dirty trick in the book to avert a looming midterm wipeout. 

If Democrats want to decisively take America back from Trump and his cronies, here's what they must do.

Video

We've spent an estimated $25B on Trump's war on Iran.

Now Trump and Co. want even more money to fund the war.

But healthcare? Cut.

Food stamps? Cut.

Education? Cut.

Cancer research? Cut.

Environmental protections? Cut.

And of course, taxes on the rich? Cut.

Obscene.
Shame on the Supreme Court for what it did today. robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

A Supreme Court so fundamentally hostile to the rights of minority voters places the Court at odds with democracy itself.

This is the legacy of Chief Justice John Roberts.

I opposed his nomination back in 2005, and I stand by that.

Video
Reminder that any political party trying to make it harder to vote is sending a clear message: they can't win on their ideas alone.
I'm live with @JoyceWhiteVance to discuss the latest Supreme Court ruling. Join us. robertreich.substack.com/liv…

Think it's time to reform the Supreme Court?

Here's how.

Video

OpenAI’s circular deals with other Big Tech giants, worth hundreds of billions of dollars, are helping inflate the stock market.

But the company has recently missed its own targets for revenue and new users.

If the AI bubble bursts, OpenAI won’t be stuck holding the bag — you will. Watch. nitter.net/RBReich/status/2…

After ICE bought a vacant warehouse to convert into a detention facility, residents of the conservative town of Roxbury, NJ have come together to halt its construction.

There's a great pushback to Trump's fascism happening across the entire country — even in deep red areas. boltsmag.org/ice-warehouse-d…

$400M for Trump's ballroom?

On top of:
-$1.5T for the Pentagon
-$170B for ICE and Border Patrol
-$1B to refurbish Trump's Qatar jet
-$496M to send National Guard into cities
-$230M for Trump's DOJ "compensation"
-$100M for Trump's golf outings

But nothing for working people.

380 workers die on the job every day.

On Workers’ Memorial Day, we remember the lives lost — and remind ourselves that workplace safety protections are a matter of life and death.

But the agency that keeps workers safe is being gutted by Trump.

Video

An actual king understands democracy better than Trump.

Video

Donald Trump wants you to think that the least powerful people in this country are the most responsible for your problems.

But you can’t deport your way out of a rigged economy.

Former FTC Commissioner @BedoyaUSA explains how economic populism can bring workers of all stripes together — and is the only real antidote to Trumpism.

Here's how.

The John Roberts Court has done more to reduce the political power of poor people and Black people while enlarging the voting rights of rich people and corporations than has any court since Roger Taney was Chief Justice in the 1800s.

I opposed his nomination in 2005, and I stand by that.
